A short reminder for anyone travelling with a pet.

Travel Notice for Pet Owners

Travelers with pets should review their check-in and carriage arrangements before departure so that each animal travels safely and comfortably with Aurelia Skyways. The Companion Animal Travel Desk is here to help with the documents, carrier checks, and any special care notes that may be needed.

Our ground team handles carriers with care between services, and the senior coordinator oversees daily service decisions. If a delay affects your journey, <<FACT F109>> Please keep your pet calm, secure, and ready for inspection when asked, and make sure all required paperwork is available at the airport.

If you are traveling with a companion animal, please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk for guidance before you go. We will help you prepare with confidence and care.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
